name: com.unity.cloud.identity
description: The identity package provides client support for all Identity and Access Management (IAM) service features

_upm.changelog:
### Added
- Added official support for the latest LTS Editor 2022.3 while maintaining support for 2021.3.

### Changed
- Default `PkceConfiguration` TokenUrl, RefreshTokenUrl and LogoutUrl no longer use cloud service endpoints.
- [Breaking] WebGL platform use secure document.cookie instead of HTTP headers to reach cloud service endpoints.

samples.description: Initialize an authenticator to demonstrate how to log in a user.
Use an authenticator to retrieve information about the logged-in user.
